name: Capture.
source:
Enjoy a cozy Christmas Eve with your best friend and significant other.  Talk  about your favourite memories, partake in fun and festive activities, and remember to capture the moment.

[From [url=https://nesste-a-rt.itch.io/capture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与你最好的朋友和重要的其他人一起享受舒适的圣诞夜。谈论你最喜欢的回忆，参加有趣的节日活动，并记得捕捉这一刻。
